fullPassage: Some people believe that vaccines cause autism. Although it's easy to ignore such factually incorrect beliefs, we should take a closer look at how people come to this kind of conclusion. Actually, we all have certain human characteristics that can lead to the denial of scientific facts. Conditions that don't have an obvious cause, such as autism, make us uncomfortable, so we tend to fill the gaps in our knowledge with unproven connections. What's more, when facing something that seems to be a risk, we often come up with the worst possible scenarios in our minds rather than approaching the situation rationally. This is what happens with vaccines — people who don't understand them find it easy to imagine they're harmful, despite the data that shows this is untrue.

questions.passage: Some people believe that vaccines cause autism. Although it's easy to ignore such factually incorrect beliefs, we should take a closer look at how people come to this kind of conclusion. Actually, we all have certain human characteristics that can lead to the denial of scientific facts. Conditions that don't have an obvious cause, such as autism, make us uncomfortable, so we tend to __________ in our knowledge with unproven connections. What's more, when facing something that seems to be a risk, we often come up with the worst possible scenarios in our minds rather than approaching the situation rationally. This is what happens with vaccines — people who don't understand them find it easy to imagine they're harmful, despite the data that shows this is untrue.

det.analysis:
❌ ① bridge the divide(차이를 좁히다): 지식의 공백을 메우는 맥락과 다름
❌ ② close the deal(거래를 성사시키다): 비즈니스 표현으로 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ set the stage(발판을 마련하다): 문맥상 공백 메우기와 다른 의미
✅ ④ fill the gaps(공백을 메우다): 지식의 '공백을 메우려' 입증되지 않은 연결고리로 ← 정답
det.tip: fill the gaps=공백을 메우다. fill the gaps in our knowledge=지식의 공백을 메우다

❌ ④ rely on data-driven conclusions(데이터 기반 결론에 의존하다): 합리적 접근과 유사하여 대조가 성립하지 않음
